Become an Operator Food in Beuningen and monitor the complete production process within a modern food production environment. Earn a monthly salary between € 3,180,- and € 3,545,- including shift allowance, work in a two-shift system and receive a direct contract with the company.

The Operator Food position requires technical insight, analytical skills and a proactive attitude.

As a warehouse operator, you will work in a dynamic logistics environment where chilled and frozen products are stored and distributed for various clients. You will work within fixed shifts: 07:00 to 18:00, 09:00 to 19:00, and 14:00 to 23:00 or 00:00. At the start, you can indicate your preference for two out of the three shifts. Based on your preference, you will be scheduled as much as possible in one fixed shift, providing structure and clarity in your working week.

In this role, you are responsible for maintaining an efficient and safe flow of goods within the warehouse. You will operate a reach truck daily to move pallets and pick orders. In addition, you will be involved in loading and unloading trucks, receiving and checking incoming goods, and managing stock locations. You will work with scanners and a modern WMS system, ensuring all processes are registered in real time and the logistics operation runs smoothly. You will also perform regular inventory checks and ensure all administrative processes are accurate. As you will be working in a chilled and frozen warehouse environment, appropriate workwear is provided to ensure you can work safely and comfortably. You are responsible for maintaining product quality and food safety by storing and handling goods at the correct temperatures and following FIFO and LIFO procedures.

With your accuracy, work pace, and sense of responsibility, you are an essential part of the logistics process and contribute directly to a reliable supply chain.

Do you want to work in a stable logistics organization where your efforts truly matter? Apply now and we will contact you shortly.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English 
- Experience with order picking
- Forklift or Reach truck certificate 
- You are a team player and work accurately and safely
